summary: Learn how to foster a knowledge-sharing culture in your organization. Enroll in our training to enhance collaboration, innovation, and employee engagement.
lede: Knowledge-sharing culture training helps professionals make organizational know-how easier to capture, find, and reuse. For team leaders, project managers, knowledge and records staff, and other professionals, it covers mapping knowledge flows, running after-action reviews and communities of practice, and selecting tools and routines that support sharing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who rely on knowledge flow to deliver results: HR and learning and development professionals. Department heads and team leaders. Project and program managers in public, private, and NGO sectors. Knowledge management and records officers. Strategy, research, and innovation teams. IT and digital transformation teams responsible for collaboration platforms. Operations and quality improvement specialists. Internal communications and culture champions. Business continuity and risk professionals concerned with knowledge loss. Anyone tasked with building collaboration and organizational learning.
modules: Processes for Capturing and Reusing Knowledge
Communities of Practice and Peer Learning
Facilitating Sessions that Produce Usable Knowledge
